overview: 29 official Qs (2008, 2012, 2017, 2019, 2025). Ecology concepts dominate recently: 2025 Mains asked 10 (definitions, food chains, producers, cycles) in statement, A-R and matching formats. Biodiversity, CITES, IUCN, biosphere reserves and wildlife efforts appear as one-liners on locations, full forms, themes and 'father of'.

possibility.angle: Basic ecology concepts: ecosystem unit, biomass, natality, density, biogeochemical cycles
possibility.what_they_ask: Exact definition of a term (density, natality, biomass), functional unit of ecology, which cycle's reservoir is not soil
Producers (photo- and chemo-autotrophs), grazing vs detritus chain start, biotic factor–feature matching

possibility.angle: Types of ecosystems, ecotones, biome latitudes, plant adaptations
possibility.what_they_ask: Which is NOT an ecotone, forest type by latitude, leaf form in dry climate

possibility.angle: Meaning and components of biodiversity, species identification
possibility.what_they_ask: Where species richness is highest, DNA barcoding for species ID
Criteria (endemic plants + threat); natural targets: India's 4 hotspots

possibility.angle: Loss of biodiversity and IUCN categories
possibility.what_they_ask: Cause of coral bleaching (zooxanthellae), meaning of CR
Location of NBPGR, Svalbard seed vault

possibility.angle: Plans, targets, conventions, days and years
possibility.what_they_ask: World Wetlands Day theme, International Year of Biodiversity, IUCN full form
Other name (Washington Convention); natural targets: 1973 signing, India joined 1976, Appendices I-III
State animal of AP, national fish/aquatic animal

possibility.evidence: 1 Q: 2017; frequent in other APPSC exams
possibility.what_they_ask: State of a named BR (Pachmarhi = MP); natural targets: Nilgiri first BR, Gulf of Mannar corals, Seshachalam in AP

possibility.angle: Indian wildlife efforts, parks, sanctuaries, people
possibility.what_they_ask: Which park is NOT a UNESCO site, AP sanctuary/deer park district, father of Indian ornithology, national aquatic animal

traps.trap: Descriptor of the thing offered as its 'theme' [nickname ≠ theme]
traps.spot: Day/theme question with popular nicknames among options
traps.fix: Wetland nicknames ('kidneys of the landscape', 'biological supermarkets') are never themes; WWD 2017 = Wetlands for Disaster Risk Reduction
traps.pyq: 'Kidneys of Landscape' → Wetlands for Disaster Risk Reduction [mains-2017-paper1#25]

traps.spot: Food chain said to start with dead leaves
traps.fix: Grazing chain starts with living producers; detritus chain starts with dead organic matter
traps.pyq: 'Grazing food chain begins with dead leaves' → A false, R true [mains-2025-paper2#139]

traps.spot: Definition options: total number, distribution, raw sample count
traps.fix: Density = individuals per unit area (or volume); total = population size
traps.pyq: 'total number of individuals' → per unit area [mains-2025-paper2#124]

traps.spot: 'Choose the correct statement' on trophic roles
traps.fix: Consumers are heterotrophs and cannot make food; some archaea are chemoautotrophic producers
traps.pyq: 'Consumers are heterotrophs able to produce their food' false → Archaea producers using chemical energy [mains-2025-paper2#136]

traps.trap: Famous park that is not a UNESCO site
traps.fix: Kaziranga, Keoladeo, Sundarbans are natural WHS; Gir (lions) is not

traps.spot: Symbiont list mixing soil bacteria and algae
traps.fix: Coral symbionts are zooxanthellae; Rhizobia = legume nodules; Azotobacter = free-living N-fixer

traps.spot: Convention 'also known as' with other city-named treaties
traps.fix: CITES = Washington 1973; Kyoto/Paris are climate; Geneva = humanitarian

traps.trap: One-half of a two-part criterion offered
traps.spot: Options list 'endemic plants' alone and 'endemic plants and threat'
traps.fix: Hotspot needs both: ≥1,500 endemic vascular plants AND ≥70% habitat lost
traps.pyq: 'Endemic flowering plant' alone → Endemic flowering plant and threat perception [mains-2017-paper1#77]

traps.fix: Ecotone = transition between two systems (river bank, mangrove, marsh); a teak forest is one system

techniques.name: Definition precision test [word by word]
techniques.how: Read each option as a definition and test the key word (per unit area, living vs dead, rate vs amount). Only the exact one survives.
techniques.example: Biomass = total mass of organisms per unit area at a given time, not a rate [mains-2019-paper1#59]

techniques.name: A-R split
techniques.how: Judge A alone, then R alone, then the link. If A is false, the answer is fixed whatever R says.
techniques.example: A (grazing chain from dead leaves) false; R (autotrophs pass energy to herbivores) true → 'A not correct but R correct' [mains-2025-paper2#139]

techniques.name: Gradient reasoning
techniques.how: Use the latitude/moisture gradient: diversity falls equator → poles; leaves shrink and thicken as climate dries.
techniques.example: Species per unit area highest → tropical rain forest [mains-2017-paper1#78]; dry climate leaf → small and thick [mains-2017-paper1#68]

techniques.name: Anchor-pair matching
techniques.how: Fix the surest pair, strike codes without it, then fix a second.
techniques.example: Saprotrophs = recycling nutrients (b-I) and humans = top heterotrophs (a-II) leave options 2 and 3; camel = little urine (d-III) → a-II, b-I, c-IV, d-III [mains-2025-paper2#137]

techniques.name: Full-form letter check
techniques.how: Expand each letter: IUCN Union-Conservation-Nature; CR = Critically Endangered; reject invented categories.
techniques.example: 'Critically extinct' is not a category → Critically endangered [mains-2025-paper2#141]

confusions.remember: Living plants → herbivores vs dead matter → decomposers
Per unit area vs total count
Standing amount at an instant vs rate of production
Barcoding identifies species; fingerprinting identifies individuals
Coral algae vs legume root-nodule bacteria
CR still in the wild; EW survives only in captivity
Global doomsday vault vs India's national gene bank
Dolphin = notified national aquatic animal (2009); national fish not formally notified
Pachmarhi wholly in MP's Satpura range
First three are UNESCO natural sites; Gir and Kanha are not

anchors: Ecosystem = structural and functional unit of ecology (Tansley 1935)
Hotspot: ≥1,500 endemic vascular plants + ≥70% habitat loss; India has 4
IUCN founded 1948; Red List: EX, EW, CR, EN, VU, NT, LC
2010 = International Year of Biodiversity; 2011-2020 UN Decade on Biodiversity
Gangetic river dolphin = National Aquatic Animal (2009)
Salim Ali = father of Indian ornithology
Svalbard seed vault = Norway; NBPGR = New Delhi
Wildlife (Protection) Act 1972; Project Tiger 1973; Project Elephant 1992
checklist: Is the stem a definition? Test the key qualifier (per unit area, living/dead, rate/amount)
In A-R, judge A first; a false A settles it
Is a nickname or descriptor posing as a theme or category?
For two-part criteria, pick the option with both parts
For park/reserve questions, confirm both state and status (UNESCO, BR, NP)
Expand acronyms letter by letter (IUCN, CR, CITES)
